messages:
Maya R.: FYI found duplicated usage lines on an AWS Marketplace invoice for reseller NorthWave. Two lines charge same qty under different meterDimension names.

Ethan S.: invoice id? quick paste the lines.

Maya R.: INV-2025-04-04123
Excerpt:
```
Line 54: SUB-9922 | metering.dimension=token_count | qty=8,400 | charge=$84.00
Line 55: SUB-9922 | metering.dimension=token_count_total | qty=8,400 | charge=$84.00
```

Rosa L.: that looks like the token_count vs token_count_total issue we've seen. billing ingestion had a small spike on 2025-04-02.

billing-bot: Ingest run marketplace-us-east-1-usage-ingest v2025.04.02 processed 65,000 events; 12 flagged ambiguous-dimension.

Ethan S.: checking usage_id and timestamps for those lines... one sec.

Ethan S.: confirmed: usage_id identical and timestamps overlap. Not additive. We should issue credit for the duplicate line (Line 55) $84.00.

Maya R.: please prepare credit memo and JE, tag accounting. Also add short note to partner ticket.

Rosa L.: will open ticket NOTE-7784: "Credited duplicate AWS metering dimension for SUB-9922; remediation PR pending to dedupe by usage_id+subscription_id."

billing-bot: Suggested fix: normalization dedupe_by = ["usage_id","subscription_id"] and prefer_primary_dimensions = ["token_count","embeddings_token_count"] ; PR #824 created in billing-ingest.

Ethan S.: draft CM attached to ticket, emailing finance@redwood.com. CM-2025-04-198 for $84.00. ETA 30m.

Maya R.: thanks — leaving for accounting signoff.

(END)
